listings.title: Headspace: Sleep & Meditation
listings.publisher: Headspace for Meditation, Mindfulness and Sleep

themes.label: Core content locked behind paywall
themes.summary: Users who previously used Headspace's free tier say most or all content, including sleep sounds, guided sessions and sleep guides, is now behind a subscription that can cost up to $100 a year. Many feel the free trial is misleading, with some reporting being charged immediately or unable to get refunds after cancelling. Several also say the change was not clearly disclosed before they created an account.
themes.recommendation: Audit the free-tier entitlement changes across versions 3.x and 4.x and the trial-to-paid flow, then test whether an unlocked trial is clearly disclosed before account creation and whether cancelled trials trigger charges, with findings reviewed by the monetization and support teams.

themes.label: Unwanted annual charges after free trial
themes.summary: Users across iOS and Android report being charged a full annual subscription after cancelling or during a free trial, often with no reminder email and no notice before the charge. Many say support refused or stalled refund requests, and some say cancellation is hard to find or doesn't stop billing, with some redirected to Apple or Google billing that they cannot locate.
themes.recommendation: Audit the free trial and renewal flow end to end: verify that cancellation in-app stops renewal on both the Apple and Google billing paths, confirm trial-to-paid conversion emails are sent at the promised 7 and 14 day marks, and set a support policy to refund charges made within a defined window after a trial cancellation.

themes.label: Paywall restricts free meditation content
themes.summary: Users across iOS and Android say the free tier has shrunk over time, so most guided meditations, courses and sleep content now require a subscription that many find expensive, especially for occasional use. Several note that the free basics or trial no longer offer enough to judge the app, and some report being charged for annual plans after trial or with unclear renewal notices. Others acknowledge the value of paid content but ask for a few basic sessions to stay free.
themes.recommendation: Audit the free-tier content mix against the 2018-2019 free offering, then A/B test a permanent set of short free guided meditations (e.g., breathing exercises) and clearer trial-end and renewal reminders, measuring conversion and refund requests.

themes.label: App crashes, freezes, and fails to load
themes.summary: Users across Android and iOS report the app not opening, freezing on the loading screen, or crashing mid-session, with many tying the problem to a recent update and some saying meditations, videos, and downloaded content will not play. Several also describe being logged out or getting error messages, and some have requested refunds or plan to cancel their subscriptions.
themes.recommendation: Pull crash and startup logs segmented by app version (especially v8.9.0 through v8.34.1 on Android) and by the first launch after update, then prioritize a fix for the loading-screen hang and offline download playback, and publish a status update to affected subscribers.

themes.label: Free content restricted behind paywall
themes.summary: Users who originally joined for free sleepcasts say the free tier was cut from several sleep sessions to one or two, and many feel the app now pushes subscriptions constantly. Several reviewers describe the cost as unreasonable, including a user quoting nearly $170 a year, and some say they would pay for the sleep section alone if a cheaper tier existed. Reviews span 2019 to 2026, so this is a long-running tension rather than a single change.
themes.recommendation: Analyze free-to-paid conversion and churn for sleep content since the 2019 paywall changes, then test a sleep-only or lower-priced tier and a free sampling policy (for example, letting users preview one sleepcast before the paywall) against retention in an A/B experiment.

themes.label: Cluttered navigation and hard-to-find content
themes.summary: Users find the Headspace library overwhelming, with too much content and weak categorisation, so finding a specific session to play takes effort that drains the intended calm. Several recent Android v8.x reviews also report the app failing to open or getting stuck on the logo after updates, and a few iOS users say the interface feels slow and cluttered. Many reviews are strongly positive about the content itself, so the friction is mainly in discovery and stability rather than the meditations.
themes.recommendation: Investigate app launch failures on Android v8.12 to v8.14 (stuck on logo, won't open) by pulling crash and startup logs for those versions, and in parallel prototype a simplified browse view with user-created favourites lists and clearer category filters, testing it with users who report scrolling fatigue.

themes.label: Subscription cost seen as excessive
themes.summary: Most reviews in this cluster complain that Headspace is too expensive, with users calling it a money grab, saying content is locked behind payment, and noting that free content has shrunk over time (e.g., shorter intro sessions and fewer free stories). Some point to cheaper alternatives or a paywall appearing before the free trial, and a few mention the price being out of reach for people who need mental health support.
themes.recommendation: Audit the paywall and free-tier boundaries by pulling analytics on where free users drop off, and test whether showing pricing after the free trial starts (rather than before the first breathing exercise) reduces early uninstalls and one-star reviews.

themes.label: Free content locked behind paywall
themes.summary: Many long-time users say Headspace used to offer a meaningful amount of free meditation content and now most guided sessions, sleepcasts and courses require a subscription, which pushes some to cancel or uninstall. Others say the app has become bloated and harder to navigate, with cluttered content and difficult-to-find programs, though many still praise the teachers and the value of the paid plan.
themes.recommendation: Audit which sessions and sleepcasts moved behind the paywall since 2018 and define a fixed free tier (for example, a set number of guided meditations and one sleepcast), then A/B test it against conversion and churn to see whether a visible free library retains lapsed users.

reviews.t: UX so broken it causes anxiety, zero customer support
reviews.x: Headspace is going backwards. It causes me a lot of anxiety just trying to get to a session to help with that anxiety - that is a bad irony for an app that’s supposed to help. Basic user flows are incredibly broken - I can’t imagine that the developers actually use this app daily. There are a number of very basic UI bugs that have persisted for months, and the navigation of content has gotten increasingly confusing. You can’t investigate a single session without starting it - which adds spam to your session history, recommendations, and Apple Health data even if you pause it after 3 seconds. Not to mention that the Pause button looks like a Play button, because the UI has been broken for months and the devs refuse to fix it - despite their support team acknowledging that they know about it. If you find what you’re looking for in the mess (which has no filters or real tools for searching), the sessions can be good, even though the basics of playing a session are surprisingly broken (long loads, reversed UI prompts, a ‘Love’ icon that shows the opposite state, etc.). Despite the steady stream of bug-fix updates, the basic issues aren’t ever repaired. And reporting bugs has no effect, even when support reps acknowledge that they’re aware of the busted UI. As a final insult, the app is now spammed with ‘share this with a friend’ prompts. Why would I tell a friend about an app the devs put such little care into actually supporting? It feels like a naked money grab by a team that doesn’t actually care about their own app. It’s very sad given the nature of the app.
Not free at all

I used Headspace trial and I didn’t like the app, so I forgot about it. Also, they haven’t notified me properly about the trial expiration and charged me for the yearly subscription. I don’t even use this app. Complete scam, avoid at all costs.

In the past I found this app really helped with my inability to fall asleep. I recently subscribed and rather than helping me fall asleep, the app is adding to my frustration because it frequently crashes. Last night I tried 4 times to listen to a sleep cast and each time the app crashed about 5 to 10 minutes in. Disappointing because when it works, the app is really helpful.

For an app that's supposed to help with maintaining mental health and calm, it's currently doing the opposite for me. There's a frustrating unpredictability to if the app is just going to stop, everything takes ages to load, it will periodically tell me I'm offline when I'm not. And yet other times it works fine. It's normally the former though. If this continues I won't be renewing my subscription (got it cheap for first yr, not currently worth full price at all)

Signed up for a family pass a year ago during a rough time where it was really needed and did not realize it was on auto renewal. On the day it was renewed, I contacted Headspace to request a refund and cancellation. The thoughtful, compassionate, understanding “corporation” was nothing but greedy when money came between them and their virtue signalling. Stay away from them…their service isn’t worth what they charge.

This app is great for the meditation guidance. I like that you can choose your teacher, and how long or short your practice will be. But, the push to try therapy through Headspace gets annoying, especially when you already HAVE a therapist (not to mention that therapists who contract with apps are very often underpaid). I'd love a way to disable those features.
The app is so confusing and bring more anxiety, it was good years ago but now it is like YouTube, so many content irrelevant.

I've used Headspace since 2019 and loved the simplicity of it back then - it was easy to browse and discover meditations and it was a pleasant experience navigating through the app. Revisiting it more actively these past couple months, I can't believe how much it's changed for the worse. There is so much visual clutter and I feel like I'm fighting the app to find what I want. Course discovery is frustrating and there are constant and consistent app crashes - for example, when I navigate to the Explore->Meditations->Courses and Singles page, I always get a crash. It's so frustrating! Not to mention - why does it take so many taps to get to a page where it's not just curated sublists of meditations and I can browse every course? I don't need my meditation app to be Netflix! Lastly, it's pushing the AI chat too much. I tap into it by accident at least once every time I open the app, which is super annoying!l Headspace has gone the way of looking like a noisy entertainment platform and it's super frustrating to see.
The content is good, but these days it often doesn’t load

This app is currently unusable, as much as the content is excellent. Reinstalling, battery optimisation settings, nothing works. It's not possible to relax or be immersed when you're constantly wondering if every bit of silence is an intentional pause in the audio or the error message coming up for the hundredth time. If I had known about this issue I would not have renewed a yearly subscription for an app that is by no means cheap.
Nothing works in this app except for Andy's meditation sessions

I have never been much for meditation or anything of the like until I tried Headspace. Now it has become something I look forward to daily, and a useful tool to help navigate life in general. I’m a pretty easy going individual, not really susceptible to stress or anxiety, but even someone like me found benefit in guided meditation. Be it helping with distractions, poor habits or just when I’m having a bad day, I can always find something in this app to help put things in perspective and help me step back a bit.
In stressing about money so I download for meditation to help calm the mind a little just to find out it cost money to use past the free trial which would just add more financial stress to me.

Been a member since 2019, might not renew again. The new update changed the way they display Sleepcasts and no longer list narrator names on the Sleepcasts page. Huge hassle! Very difficult to find favourite Sleepcasts from preferred narrators (some narrators are just not for me). I sent some feedback in and got a silly, generic reply. Will be looking for alternatives when my subscription ends. End of an era.

The app is pretty unusable on my phone (Samsung). It takes forever to open and then moving around the different tabs and pages, each one takes ages. It cuts out midway through a meditation and then says no internet connection. There are so many different things it's almost impossible to find what you're looking for. I have been after decent length meditations to start the day but can only find three minute ones. Not worth the money at all.

Used to be great. For weeks now, anything I play will randomly stop anywhere from 2 to 40 minutes in and say something went wrong. It started doing that right when everything started taking forever to load. 30+ seconds to load the home screen, another 30+ seconds to go to browse. 30+ seconds when I click on something to listen to. I don't like that one? 30+ seconds to load the browse screen again. This is on Wifi when everything on any other app loads instantly.

Just because it’s a meditation app doesn’t make these people any less profit-seeking and scammy than any other app. My subscription auto-renewed (I didn’t know it was even still active and hadn’t used it in 11 months) without a renewal email, and when I emailed support the very same day to get it cancelled and refunded they refused. Avoid this app. Use Insight Timer instead, it’s mostly free and the people are a lot nicer.

Ever since they overhauled this app last year it's been useless. It takes forever to load, assuming it ever does, and it frequently informs me I'm offline even though I'm not. I start sessions and talking stops a minute in with an "oops something went wrong." Yes what went wrong is your coders. You need a new development team or better yet toss out this new version and go back to the old one. It worked fine. BTW I'm a 10 year lifetime member so I've seen all the transformations.
Merci

It's hard to believe that a successful programme such as headspace has such a poor app. It takes a very long time to load, freezes frequently and, what annoys me the most, stops working mid meditation every single time I'm using it. I've been a user since the beginning and it's sad how the price has gone up whilst experience has gone down to a point where I'm considering switching to another provider.
LITERALLY NOTHING IS FREE BRO 💔

I typically use the sleep portion of the app. I love the sleep casts and the sleep sounds. What I don't love is the app crashing every time I open it, or stopping playback less than 2 minutes into anything I play. I am connected to wifi, it shouldn't be disconnecting all the time. It really pulls me from drifting off to have whatever I'm playing abruptly stop.

Not so Free Trial. I attempted to sign up for a free trial, but it glitched and ended up skipping the free trial, locking in my payment for the year. I have reached out to customer service twice, explaining what happened and that I had the app less than 36 hours, so I would have been well within my free trial period. They just keep saying all sales are final. Reading what other people have said suggests this is not uncommon occurrence. They put money and rigid rules above people and compassion

I've been using this for years and recommending it to others as well. But with the latest update, it's become unusable. It just freezes on the home screen and won't load anything. Big disappointment. Please fix this quickly! Edited 9/1/26: no longer freezing on the home screen but still taking ages to load and then frequently just crashes a couple of minutes into sleep casts. C'mon, Headspace, sort this out! My annual subscription has just renewed otherwise I really would be looking elsewhere.
I love headspace and i have benefited from their program for years. I just wish I could restart courses once I begin them!
This company refuses a credit for $90 when my elderly mother doesn’t use the service and didn’t know it would renew. I will never use their services again.
Love the take 10 series and chance to practice mindfulness.

J’utilise cet appli depuis presque de 2 ans et, a plusieurs niveaux, je l’aime beaucoup. D’abord, la voix de méditation est très douce et calme, que je préfère à celle de l’appli Calm (Sandrine), j’aime la simplicité d’utilisation, malgré que la méditation du jour pourrait être mieux accessible et j’adore les histoires pour dormir qui commencent par une petite séance de relaxation. Toutefois, il manque de nouveauté, c’est le plus gros défaut selon moi. De nouvelles histoires, nouvelles méditations, séance de respiration accompagnée de différente durée… voilà ce qui manque.
This app is very confusing and messy. It causes anxiety navigating it actually rather than helping it

I used to recommend this to everyone. Now, it seems so buggy that it is an actively bad experience. Meditations consistently fail to load. Some seem to, and then freeze at odd places, making it impossible to trust the built-in silences in those that do load - is this an expected pause or has something gone wrong? You'd think that the download option would help, but they disappear or claim to be "buffering". Really frustrating to take time out to be mindful only to end up fighting with an app.

No longer usable. I used to use the app several times a week, but recently there are so many bugs that it is impossible to use. App loads slowly, pages are not possible to navigate between (tap on another page and the same page just reloads), and when you finally get into a meditation it will stop after a couple of minutes with an error message.

The app frequently hangs and freezes. It's almost I possible to finish an entire session (some are only 20 minutes) without it crashing more than 5 times. It's highly frustrating and impossible to use. I've tried various ways to solve this issue (reinstall, restart my phone, check internet, check stor) and none of them work. Have requested a refund and hope it goes through.

Extremely disappointed and concerned that my go-to meditation app recommends talking to and taking suggestions from an AI companion/therapist that acknowledges and agrees with whatever you have to say, basically like an empathetic ChatGPT. Headspace says it's not a substitute for human care, but that's obviously how its going to be used. Headspace also collects data from your conversations to improve the service. My question is: Why is any of this necessary for a wellness app? Knowing the damage social media causes our mental well-being, why is Headspace going ALL IN on the unknown damage effects AI has on our well-being? There are cases where chatbots have encouraged users to take drastic action (do your own research) to their own health risk, never mind the environmental and ethical concerns. I find it insane that Headspace promotes serenity and well-being but then incorporates this technology as soon as it becomes available, with no concern for users. I don't care if they call it "clinical" and "throughouly tested by researchers," it's not healthy.
couldn’t find a SINGLE free thing to do in the app. ridiculous

The actual content is good, but every time I open the app to meditate there is a pop-up asking me about something if I want to try to AI bot ( I don’t ). Even if I turn off the recommendations in settings. Very annoying. I miss the version 1 app.

Glitchy and the opposite of calm when faced with the wheel of doom trying to load a sleepcast in the middle of the night... When I open the app it takes ages to load and won't move into the "explore" tab. I've been forced to listen to the programmes I've heard before, as they're on the home screen. Please fix as I love the content, I just need to be able to get to it!

Edit: Despite having a paid plan to Headspace, I have uninstalled the app. In the past year, it has caused me more frustration than peace. It is slow to start up. Often the meditations don't load at all, and it's more difficult to find the meditations I've downloaded. Previously: 5 stars. Lovely meditation app. I have had a subscription to headspace the past few years, and the experience just keeps getting better. I love all the different courses, and it's a great reminder to pause and focus.

I miss the old UX, with the daily suggestions. Simple, tailored personalizations so I’m not anxiously spending 30 minutes searching to find what to listen to. The new design just feels like a vomited repository with no user consideration in mind. And what happened to showing who’s the speaker for each card view of the content? Now I have to click on it and listen to it in order to see if it’s the speaker I prefer. Definitely took a step back in terms of design, such a shame.
Not a free trial when you are immediately charged!

reviews.t: For travel class, can you please add Rockies in Canada
reviews.x: I love Headspace. I use it every night, but can you please add some travel cast for Banff in the Rockies in Canada? I would love that.
A reminder before auto renewal would be appreciated. Not happy with the auto renewal and cancellation policy.

Update 25/11/25: Investigated and found I was meant to have access for as long as my employment! Verifying teaching status is failing now 🙄😔. I do love the app, when I could access it for free as an educator! Without warning, one night when I was going to bed, the app had stopped my access. I assumed they only gave me 12 months of access, but no information about the subscription ending. I felt disappointed by this as I used it one night to go to sleep and the next night everything was locked.

not what it used to be. the user interface is the opposite of relaxing. it seems like such a messy app, different things everywhere. difficult to find and explore despite there being an explore tab. how about a simple search bar? and it seems all of Andy's stuff is just cut up and recycled old stuff... you can tell because the sound of his voice literally changes between the intros and the guidance. after years and years I've decided to go with a different app.

Update: 2025- Look. I love Headspace and I use it every day. I've been using it for years. But this is the buggiest app on my phone, and I have to restart it multiple times each time just to get to the library. I spend more time staring at the loading page than I do meditating. It crashes and deletes my streak all the time, even though I never miss a day. I will keep my subscription and keep using it, but the Headspace team has some serious repairs to do.

The sleep meditations are too short, and the ones that should be quiet and calming (like sleep) start with a jarring voice that sounds like an ad. Ebb is fun but it gets my requests wrong. I remember the original Headspace was very simple and cute which made me want to meditate. this new app is overwhelming. Every time I use it, I get turned off. Also - use a compressor on the voices so there's less dynamic range. the uneven volume makes for a poor listening experience. I will not be renewing.

Signed up for a 14 day free trial but was instantly charged 90 usd. I’ve seen several other people say the same thing happened to them, which means headspace knows about this and hasn’t fixed it. Absolutely ridiculous.

Very disappointed in this app. Scheduled my first coaching session. The app kept kicking me out of the session for no reason. Wouldn't let me send messages. The coach couldn't connect to the chat either, at times. Sleep stories sometimes just randomly pause. There are very long periods of silence in sleep stories, which makes no sense at all. App constantly freezes and crashes. It actually will create anxiety as opposed to relieve it when you use this app. Uninstalling.

App used to be amazing, but its terrible lately. I have a premium account, which isn't cheap, but I've had it for several years now. I use the Sleepscapes for going to sleep at night, which was the only thing that saved me after insomnia. But recent months, the app has been going downhill. Recents don't update. The heart for favourites are gone. And now for the last week the app won't even load so I can't access anything, not even my account to cancel my recurring payment.
A pop up message came up and stayed on the entire night draining my battery and damaging my phone. This is some ridiculously bad engineering. Should be 0 stars.

J’écoute Héloïse (version francophone) et toutes ses méditations guidées m’aident beaucoup, moi qui débute dans ce domaine. Après 2 semaines, je peux affirmer que j’ai pris conscience de ma respiration et que j’arrive à intégrer de petits exercices simples par moi-même lorsque j’en ressens le besoin, je recommande!

reviews.t: Apple Watch companion app removed with no notice
reviews.x: No explanation on their website either, which still claims if exists. Removed the main way I want to interact with the app.

I love the concept of headspace and I think it is so important, I recently downloaded again because I am in the early stages of burnout. However, I soon remembered why I stopped using it a few years ago.... the teachers dont leave any space for you to follow through thr instruction and it is so distracting. For example, they might say, for the next few moments let your mind go free, but then immediately start talking it gives you no time, it is not relaxing and actually a but irritating.

OMG NO, I SERIOUSLY CAN'T BELIEVE THIS! This version brought back the bug of the screen turning off if you didn't touch it during a workout. And it's really annoying and frustrating. It basically did the "move" category unusable. I wanna open play, watch and do at the same time, whatever yoga session or workout, and my phone screen locks, after the time I have for "screen out", this didn't happen! It's like when you're watching YouTube or Netflix. You can't be touching your screen every 10 min!
wow. imagine being a FREE app. tsk tsk tsk… 5 stars-
You literally can’t use ANYTHING without paying so unfair

Not a single one exercise or podcast is free how am I supposed to know if the application’s going to help me if I can’t try it. People just want to be help with their anxiety or stress not spend a 20$ per month.

I love Headspace and use the app nearly every day for my practice but I there are some small things that frustrate me each time. Mainly about the fact that there is no way to save your preferences, which means I have to select my preferred meditation duration and teacher every time I listen to a meditation as it always defaults to Andy at 3 minutes. This small change would make for such a smoother, more personalised experience.

I enjoyed the limited free meditation options offered by the app. However, recently, Headspace has decided that what their free users need is an AI “companion”. I am beyond insulted by the suggestion that this company thinks a program without empathy, understanding, nor accountability could make an appropriate emotional support for any human being. I am uninstalling the app in response. I won’t be reinstalling.

reviews.t: Needs better organization of personal favourites or saved content
reviews.x: Great app but it would be really helpful to have a page of favourites that can then be categorized by sleep, stress, stretching, breathing etc. this would greatly enhance the user experience and make the app much more useful for people. Currently, I can only see a couple of my favourites at a time and then I have to scroll left. It would also likely help with retention as right now, it doesn’t seem at all like my own personal space/library. As long as there is similar content, I could use any app. Please think about this headspace!

Note: this updated review score is for the app only, not the content. The app continues, even 5 years later, to be underwhelming, confusing, and often buggy. Almost nothing appears to be stored on your device (despite a 300-400 MB download size), meaning every time you load a page in the app, everything is downloaded as if you're browsing a webpage. This means Headspace is an absolute data hog if you're trying to conserve data usage.

The content of headspace is fantastic, and mostly accessible on their website. The app however is absolutely terrible. 9 out of 10 times it refuses to load and gets stuck on the loading splash forcing me to clear the cache, then data, then uninstall before restarting my device and then reinstall the app. Even this works only half of the time!! A quick Google shows this is an ongoing problem, and has been for a long period of time and ultimately led to a 1.7 star rating on trust pilot. Shame.

I enjoy using this app daily, especially the section where it suggest you a list of what to start your day with. However, the latest update made it un-usable. 4 out of 5 times I could not open the app, it turns into a blank screen and refuses to load. The other 1 time that it loads, it takes almost 2 minutes to get the app started, and even then each item takes an additional 1 min to load even though I have pre-downloaded them. Please fix this, you can have an amazing product, but not available

Not sure what happened to this app, my second year of using it and it became so slow. I have to restart the app several times just to open it. Recently I started to encounter problems where it wouldn't open at all, so can't even acces the app anymore. For the price I'm paying it's very upsetting. Not to mention that there's still no option to favorite/save meditations to different folders so I can navigate quickly among all my fav content. Might be time to move on if they don't address these.

I love the headspace app and have been using it for years! The only thing is that my app keeps switching to french for some reason since the update and I have to reinstall it every few days despite the language setting being turned to english as always😞 Any help is appreciated!

Headspace is incredible. I've been using it for almost 10 years. It has everything from guided meditations for all different types of situations and worries to sleepcasts and exercise routines to help you unwind. I feel the recent addition of Ebb makes it truly special. Headspace is on my phone's homepage, and I use it almost every day. I have used the long courses and short daily meditations. If you want an introduction to minfulness or struggle with worry, anxiety, or stress, get Headspace.

While I like it to remind me to relax, it is sloooooooow. It takes forever to load initially and as you switch between the screens it takes even longer to load. I have to constantly close out of the app and go back in just to get the main page to load. When I'm frustrated, stressed or overwhelmed, have the app take so long to load to get to the exercises is NOT helpful. It defeats the purpose.

Headspace as an approach to meditation- great. As an app? Awful. I have been a subscriber since 2019, and it feels like every update the app gets worse. Interface changes too frequently, and constant bugs. Most recently the bugs are affecting my meditation practice.

Was using the app several years ago and it was very simple and straight forward... Now there is a mix of learning, meditation and advices, sometimes mixed in one recording... Very inconvenient if you are looking for a meditation app. Another ploblems: 1. In the end of some recordings the app stucks and no button works. 2. Some recordings finishes without any notice, you don't understand if it's the end or a pause between words. 3. There is no background music in the meditations

Content overload. While I used to enjoy the daily meditations, I now get lost in the content and find the meditations more like lessons with to much talking and not enough silence to actually meditate

Mindfulness and meditation is important, and a company that takes that need and tries to manipulate you frequently to buy therapy needs to be avoided and warned against. It’s an average app at best, the ui is often in the way and hard to find what you’re looking for. I always liked the aesthetic but competitor apps are much better. They’ve added AI as well which is concerning as I don’t trust this company at all. Safe to assume that should be a concern as well Turning off all notifications will not stop them from adverting to you through notifications- you need to turn them off in iOS Overall, shame on you Headspace. Profits over your purpose isn’t surprising, but you should be ashamed for what you’re doing Annual membership cancelled and customer lost for life.

I use the desktop/iPad app to listen to music for focused work and I love the Zoom Out track. Since 2 updates ago, there are jarring audio stutters every few seconds that result in complete silence or pause for a second. This makes the app unusable for me. Thankfully the webapp does not have this issue. I’m on the latest macOS Sequoia 15.7. Please fix this!

I have used the free trial and unsubscribed from the app , yet the app kept taking money from my account until they have successfully taken an annual subscription fee. this app wasn't what I needed and I left it after few minutes of looking through it, yet I have been charged an annual fee of $92. Beware of unsubscribing from free trial as it is not an obvious process. I had to cancel my cards and had to get my bank involved UNACCEPTABLE

I like the content; I've been using it for stress and to help me sleep, and I think it is effective. That said, the app is terrible; it's constantly showing error messages. I was following one of the courses and one day it just stopped working. The content wouldn't open on my phone. I reported it and their help team said they would get on it at some point. Last night the app wouldn't open; today it has logged me out and won't let me back in - it says my email isn't registered with them anymore

Downloaded meditations cannot be accessed when in airplane mode. After opening, the app only shows a loading circle and after a few minutes the following message "Hmm...that's weird Something went wrong. Could you try again in a few moments?" Reinstalling did not work and also not on a different phone. Otherwise great for meditation, as long as you have Internet.

I've been using the app for many years now and I really like how the library has grown through this time. All the videos and podcasts are very interesting. However after the latest update half of the videos don't load! Neither the breathing excersises work! Which is very annoying and has disrupted my meditation routine!! I've sent them an email as well but received no reply.
I used to have this app and at least there were more than two free options. How is anyone able to even know this app is good enough for a subscription??? Very sad.

I love the music playlists and the noise I can listen to as background noise when doing stuff, they are absolutely amazing. But the app is extremely unstable; it crashes like crazy, frequently stops, and the page loading is as slow as the landline speed in the 90s. Two stars deducted because of those. I just bought a brand new Samsung, and the issue carried over, so I can rule out the device cause. And the app is up to date. I am leaving the review because IT JUST CRASHED 4 TIMES IN A MINUTE.

Cannot stand the new layout of favourites. The one place I come to relieve my stress just brings me more stress. Just leave the list vertical. It’s more natural to the human eye and user friendly. We don’t all want AI and upgraded technology and we are the ones paying for this app.

reviews.t: Why the complete change in the “today” function?
reviews.x: Updated the app, opened and to my incredible disappointment, the checklist layout of the today tab is gone. Why? The today tab now is useless, it feels like this is push to use the new AI bot.

… finding what you need is a just so inefficient and that’s the absolute opposite of what’s required from an app like this!! It also goes around in circles sometimes too. The whole menu approach needs radically reworked. I’d also like to see profiles so kids stuff be separate (my toddler has started to request her own bedtime meditations but between my stuff and now hers my menu is a mess). You can’t find the good for you amongst the not quite right for you is the biggest downfall of this app. I’ll continue paying simply bc the bedtime stuff works for myself and my toddler so well. But gosh it’s frustrating nonetheless, and I wish I could get more from this app but it just doesn’t feel friendly enough menu wise and I haven’t the time nor patience to invest in working around that. On top of this, forcing your hand for when to update the app (no pre warning or buffer time… maybe I’m just not being very mindful, but I wanted a sleepcast and sleep at that time anyway; not an app update). Lastly, no deals for loyal customers… only deals for newbies. I’m not sure I’m gonna renew next time. It’s beginning to feel too performative and not real enough.

I am a brazilian living in Canada and I always have trouble sleeping. Headspace relly saved me when I discovered it three years ago and up until now I have only used headspace for sleeping purposes I listen in english and portuguese there are new english sleepcasts every three-two weeks but portuguese its the same thing for THREE YEARS
I couldn’t be more happy with this app and what it does to train the mind in a very digestible and comfortable way. Recommend for anyone dealing with sleep issues and anxiety.
I was expecting to get at least a little content for free. Unfortunately it seems everything is behind their paywall.

I have used this app for years paying the full subscription price the whole time and loved it. However in the last few months with their recent updates, the app is very slow to open, load into different pages and often just doesn't respond. If I then get it to work, the sleep music and stories etc. crackle or have strange jumps and pauses and then ultimately crash after 10 mins. Unfortunately, this is every day when I use the app and none of their advice on fixing the issue works.

La santé mentale est quelque chose de très important. Encore plus pour les jeunes. Nous courrons un gros problème avec cette application car nous ne pouvons pas avoir d’aide sans payer. C’est vraiment dommage.
Nothing is free. I remembered using this couple years ago and the basic meditation was free. Now you have to pay for that. Might aswell just use YouTube

I love this app and have paid full price for many years. This last update has made the app very slow, also on several occasions meant that sleep stories have stopped after a couple minutes and won't restart. Refreshing the story doesn't work and happens on any story picked. Having checked the internet and my phone, it can only be the app. The stories have also become a lot quieter, when played through phone speaker, full volume is needed to hear the ambient noise, even when voice is down.

reviews.t: Besides some glitches everything is great
reviews.x: The app is great except for one thing. Lately the app keeps updating, then downgrading, along with constantly glitching and changing interfaces, so those things need to be fixed. Other than that everything else is amazing! 🙌🏼

I was going to write a review, but just read one that says exactly what I was going to say: I've been using this app daily since 2018 and used to love it. I only use the daily meditation and no other content. I've tried the other content but it's not for me. Now with the new update, they have dropped the ball completely: - I have to manually change the timer every time I want to meditate as it keeps defaulting to 3 minutes (something that didn't happen before the update). - Every day it asks me to "check in" (something that didn't happen before the update) and there's no way to turn it off. I've even emailed customer service and nothing changed. - The new layout and screen post-meditation have too many things going on after the latest update. You had a great app and with this new update, you screwed it all up. - I realized that it's not worth paying the yearly amount given that I ONLY use it for the daily meditation and nothing else. All other content on the app is useless to me. For these reasons I'm cancelling my subscription. You have lost a great customer and many future referrals as I used to tell everyone about this app and send them the 30-day free trial, after which many became subscribers. Not anymore.

With this latest update nothing is working, UI is worse. "Something went wrong" 2 minutes into meditation. "Something went wrong" I love the meditations in this app, the Sleepcasts always work for me, I've never been awake at the end of any of them. BUT there isn't much more frustrating then listening to a sleepcast, just dozing off, to find out has stopped, I have to turn on phone put on glasses to find those dreaded 3 words "Something went wrong" - even on content I've downloaded. Please fix!

reviews.t: Used to be good… NOT ANYMORE
reviews.x: I’ve been using this app daily since 2018 and used to love it. I only use the daily meditation and no other content. I’ve tried the other content but it’s not for me. Now with the new update, they have dropped the ball completely: - I have to manually change the timer every time I want to meditate as it keeps defaulting to 3 minutes (something that didn’t happen before the update). - Every day it asks me to “check in”(something that didn’t happen before the update) and there’s no way to turn it off. I’ve even emailed customer service and nothing changed. - The new layout and screen post-meditation have too many things going on after the latest update. You had a great app and with this new update, you screwed it all up. - I realized that it’s not worth paying the yearly amount given that I ONLY use it for the daily meditation and nothing else. All other content on the app is useless to me. For these reasons I’m cancelling my subscription. You have lost a great customer and many future referrals as I used to tell everyone about this app and send them the 30-day free trial, after which many became subscribers. Not anymore.
It helps provide me with a bit of introspection and just a few minutes to turn off my mind. Truly love using it.

Great app. I highly recommend it. Things that could be improved - skipping the intro of the meditations (my favourite one starts by saying "we're halfway through the week"), being able to make a playlist (back to back meditations for sleep could help us not look at our phone every 10 minutes)

Extremely interesting and helpful material. However, it's not always easy to search for, bookmark and organise preferred items. Material on neurodiversity and the related needs for focus, sleep, meditation could be included. Also, the "downloaded" option doesn't work at all. i reported this issue in the past and never got a reply or saw it fixed. I use the app because I have it for free, however I am not sure I would pay a subscription without the needed improvements.

I had high hopes for Headspace, but it’s been a letdown. The content is extremely repetitive they reuse the same videos and sessions over and over, which makes the subscription feel overpriced. You can honestly find better variety for free on YouTube. What really left a bad taste was their customer service. I forgot to turn off auto-renewal and was charged for another year, but they refused to issue a refund. For an app that claims to be about mental health and helping people, they seem far more concerned with profits than with supporting their users. Save your money and look for other (free) resources that genuinely care about their community.

I loved this app. I used it pretty much daily for two years to help me sleep, only using one sleepcast the whole time. I didn't/haven't used it for anything else. I was willing to pay the subscription for that one sleepcast. Since this last update, it takes actual minutes to load every screen or page, compared to the seconds before. Almost every touch of a button in the app makes my phone vibrate. You can't turn it off. It startles me awake. Literally invalidates my subscription.

In 2024, I subscribed to Headspace to help manage my anxiety. I really enjoyed the app. I quickly went through all the meditations, which I now know well. Since I hadn’t used it for several months, I unsubscribed from the subscription on the Apple Store last year and deleted the app. To my great surprise, this week Headspace charged my credit card a full $100 subscription for the 2025–2026 year. I don’t understand how a company can force a customer to pay for a subscription without notifying them. I contacted customer service to request a refund, but despite being a loyal customer for two years, they refused to help me and even declined a partial refund. I’m very disappointed with their service and will no longer recommend their app to anyone I know.

Love this app but it’s been really buggy lately. Asking me to “retry” often and shutting down unexpectedly. I also find their search function is really poor. I can type in the exact name of the meditation or podcast I want to listen to and it still won’t come up. It’s hard to find things later. I wish the favourite function would allow you to make different lists to organize your favourites- such as things I want to listen to in the future and ones I’ve listened to and found really helpful. Hope you make these improvements.

While I really enjoyed the sleep cast sessions that were advertised on Netflix. The ones on the app aren’t quite as good. Two major issues: 1) You’re forced to do a wind down (the app Calm doesn’t force a long one) which takes up a lot of time. They also don’t register with me and they’re repetitive so it’s a waste of time. There is no ability to rewind or press forward. Some of the breathing techniques are okay but this “every joint and muscle turns off” language that’s constantly used, along with imagining the warm sun traveling up your body, is a waste of time. Each method forces you to speak to each body part, and it’s way too time consuming. It’s not even relatable for some people, like me, and it pisses me off more than anything. 2) the Netflix examples stayed on for 4 hours with the same background music you fall asleep to. Most sleep casts on the app are 45 minutes max. I found one that was 500 minutes but when the sleep story ended, the background music suddenly changed into something totally different and woke me up. Why wouldn’t the background music stay the same after the speaker stops the story? Why do the speakers now speed through the stories? Take breaks/breaths like they did in the Netflix examples so the listener has time to start falling asleep. I personally think these are major issues. I have a calm subscription which I rather not use because I don’t care about celebrity voices, just old soothing men voices. Please address above mentioned matters to improve the app. I really don’t want to switch to the Calm app but I’m starting to get fed up.

Instead, your morning breath exercises is interrupted by a robotic A.I. generated voice telling you to do deep breaths whilst explaining visually what animation is currently happening. I’m not complaining about the AI, itself, but it can be quite disruptive when I’m met with a cold computerized command instead of a human voice giving time for me to breathe in and out. Is this really worth $13 a month? Just to breathe slower? Or am I going to listen to the same excuses by companies mentioning how they’re making record profits by cutting corners (I.e. by making me listen to AI instead of human voices)?
