I used headspace a long time ago because of how much content was freely available and then stopped for a while. When i came back to it a couple of days ago i was extremely disappointed at how every single guided meditation was locked behind a subscription, and the few free ones were short and meant to lead to other paid ones. If you are willing to spend money on the subscription it's great, but otherwise very disappointing

I started to use this app a few years ago. The teacher Andy is really key I use it. Now I can hardly find meditation guided by Andy. What’s more, the app contents are getting more and more complicated. I miss the old headspace and sad to see Andy phased out.

It saves me from insomnia, from judgement, it makes me grateful and kind, it makes me laugh and become the best version of myself. Andy, Eve and Kesonga’s voices act like a balm and just listening to them my heart and breath slow down. Breathe in, breathe out. Everything will be okay
Great people, helping people. Understanding people, helping guide people with a healthier life journey. Keep up the awesome work Headspace staff.
Everyday I start with headspace as my morning routine! It has everything I need to get started mindfully!

I used this app when I was going through some difficult times while I was pregnant. Worked great! Fast forward a couple years and I'm going through some stuff so wanted to get back in to it... What the heck?!? Everything is locked unless I buy a subscription! There isn't even a few videos unlocked so you get enticed... Basics are even locked!!! Totally has gone downhill! Do not waste your money!
Even though I am a beginner- I notice the difference in days that I do make time for headspace and in days that I have missed or just can’t engage. This is a great tool for everyone.

I’ve tried a few other apps and platforms, but I always find my way back to Headspace. I’ve used it for years, and I love the additions of yoga and movement meditations, as well as the extensive course library and new teachers. 10/10!

There is soo much in the app it is overwhelming. I think we are so carried away by the idea that having a lot of features or resources is better, or some form of marketing to get more people on(?) The true purpose should be simplicity and calm. Th guided meditation is great, the narration is great. But when I open the app I think it makes me even more anxious than calm.

reviews.t: Collection for women and black joy?
reviews.x: Who came up with the idea to have a mediation collection specifically for people “identifying as women” and Black people? Do we have collections for very single other identity group? Why does a mediation app have to divide and discriminate ??! Ridiculous.

The app itself is great! My problem is that nothing is free. I used to use this app about a year ago and they had a several things you could still do that didn't cost money. Now absolutely nothing is free. Not even some of the guided tutorials about how to use the app! A yearly subscription is one penny short of 70 dollars and a monthly is 13$. They have gone from helpful to annoying really quickly. I will no longer be using Headspace.

reviews.t: No recommended for ADHD or anxiety
reviews.x: I got this app to help me slow down. There are too many options. The interface is confusing, the videos are not helpful at all. Do not get this app.

Great content, but mediocre app. Doesn't reliably record when you finish a lesson and won't let you skip ahead, so often need to repeat them. Can't download sleepcasts for offline use. Constantly updating UI in arbitrary ways. Missing many basic features (rewind/fast forward, queue, reset course before finishing...) Maybe goal is to make you more accepting because things are out of your control? I don't know. Result is just that app is frustrating.

Don't waste your time or money. Their content is not worth it. I canceled within the 7 day free trial and deleted the app. I just got charged for an annual membership yesterday. The membership I canceled. And the only way to request a refund is to go through their site and find the account and email them and hope they get back to me. I can't get help from the Play Store because to them I already canceled. Don't waste your time and get more stress than without this app.

I'm going around in circles. Choose the free trial with £4.99 per month there after the 14 days. I put in my PayPal details, email, phone number. Generally everything requested, but rather than allowing me to get on with it, it keeps taking me back to the Choose free trial page. I've completed this twice, thinking, maybe I did something wrong first time, but, no back to square one again! 😢

I like the app and the content it offers but it is currently broken. I have an annual subscription with them, took a few months off and now I cannot access anything. I still have 2ish months left before I'm supposed to renew and I found the order confirmation so I know it's not that. What makes it even more infuriating is that their own help page for isn't updated for the modern version of the app. It says to go click the "restore purchase" link, but that link no longer exists. It's ridiculous.

Do not ever use or download this app! It costs $70 a year, there is no warning when the trial ends so you better not forget. Customer service takes 2 business days to receive a response via email, the phone number is only to leave a voicemail. The app is poorly organized and it doesn't keep track of "courses" properly. 2/10 The chat feature doesn't work either, it doesn't understand anything you tell it so it just loops in circles. There's so many ads, they're even part of the "daily" checklist

I like the app for what it does, it has many meditation audios. At least one problem probably more, they used to have at least some free options for those with anxiety but not really rich enough for the bill. Now they don't and I don't want to whine about costs, but it is an important factor when it comes to anxiety! I really want to like it, but now it seems like they're only in it for the money gained, not for true mental health. If it wasn't so pricey, I might've given it more of a shot...

This app got me through some major panic attacks a few years ago, so I started paying even though there were some free options available. After the economy took a dive and I was laid off, I canceled my subscription temporarily. Having a panic attack this morning I opened up the app to get in a quick free 3 minutes only to find the app has become this overwhelming monster of a thing with several speakers now instead of the intimate 2, and ZERO free options. So I wound up deleting the app altogether and searching for some meditation music on YouTube. Greed wins again. Headspace is now a corporate monstrosity.

reviews.t: Very complex for this seeking simplicity
reviews.x: Used to love headspace but now there’s so much going on in the Home Screen it’s overwhelming. Everyday has like 5 suggested tasks. I wish this was modifiable as I now just find myself overwhelmed by the apps interface. The actual meditation is good though.

Not even short breathing exercises are free anymore. I love the animations, but I'm not willing to pay £7 monthly to access 1-minute-content. Please think about this - especially in these trying (and especially expensive!) times, if you can't do it for free, at least a mini-subscription model would eminently make sense (for example £1 month/£10 yearly for exercises of 1 minute or breathing exercises).
I signed up for the free trial - just to get hit with a $90 annual subscription 2 minutes later. Thanks but no thanks Unreal.

This is the only app I have that makes me better as a person. Great design, works wonderfully, fantastic coaches to guide you through meditation. I do wish it had a feature for background sound during meditations. It would make it easier to release the thought that the app wasn't working or that the meditation had ended when there are long pauses (it's never been an app problem).

Seems like a really great app with many mindfulness and meditation courses. However, it doesn't pre-warn you that you must pay a subscription to use any of the courses before using the app. You can start a free trial but then if you don't cancel in time, you start paying a monthly fee that can be seen as expensive during these times. If you don't pay the subscription or start the free trial, it doesn't let you use ANY of the courses. It could at least offer several basic courses for free

I used to love this app, but it's become really frustrating. Someone mentioned that after you do a meditation, it often freezes and doesn't complete. I lost a 140 day streak because of that. Also, when you open a meditation, it now starts right away instead of taking you to the description like before. You have to press a button to see the description - after you've waited several seconds for the meditation to buffer and start. And then you find out it doesn't even suit you. Just why?

I tried to like it but a lot of things were off limits unless I paid a subscription. It was overwhelming I dont know if there were free things but I couldn't find it over the locked ones. It looks cool, though I'm broke and tired so it isnt easy on my mind. I'm uninstalling until it may easy up in the future? Don't know, not for me though.
Really headspace… the basics course and a few sleep stories were too much to offer for free so you took it all away?? Shame on you, what a distasteful move.

EDIT 2: Suddenly had an issue where the app wouldn't load correctly after updating. Uninstalled the app, restarted my phone, then got locked out of my account with endless loading. After a few days, with no further updates or changes, it fixed itself. The app seems to have technical issues. Otherwise nice meditations; if you can afford it or get it through insurance.

NO FREE MEDITATIONS, don't download this if you aren't willing to pay their subscription, $70 a year. To the developer, if you're going to put everything behind a pay wall then why let a user go into your menu where everything is locked? Just tell them on the splash page they have to subscribe to use the app. Don't give the impression there's some free functionality, your current implementation is deceitful.

I have been a paying subscriber for a number of years now. I used to really love this app for its variety and guidance and took a lot from it that helped reshape my perspective in life into a more positive one. I also heavily relied on it for sleep, using the guided meditations and soundscapes. However, now I find repetitive content throughout and the sleep content feels very limited. Much of it is the same. I would really love to see a change.
All of the stuff is locked it’s a ripoff I just wanted to listen to some sleep music and none one them are open. I hate this app.

reviews.t: New update takes away favourite feature
reviews.x: You can no longer access individual sessions from a course, now have to restart the course which is extremely annoying

reviews.t: Can’t do anything without paying now :(
reviews.x: Use to be able to watch the Basics one but even that requires a subscription now. Not worth $18 a month

This really shouldn't be listed as a free app anymore. Without a subscription or a brief 'free' trial, there is now absolutely nothing you can do in it. I'll leave a star because I've been a subscriber in the past and I know the content is good, but locking even the few little exercises that used to be freely accessible away is an uninstall for me.

I've had this app since 2018 and I've been using the free options like the basics course and sleepcast. Suddenly 2022 comes around and NOTHING is free on this app and I mean NOTHING. Not any courses, not any music, not even "take 5 deep breaths" is free. What on Earth happened? I hope there's a good explanation for this because I am disappointed. Uninstalling and never recommending to anyone.
Not giving this app any stars because it should tell people that there is a fee per month. I deleted the app

reviews.t: Remember to cancel before free trial ends!
reviews.x: You are immediately subscribed for the entire year. All you can do is unsubscribe from auto renew 12 months later. I liked the app, but not worth $101.69 Cdn

Absolutely great. I have OCD and this app has taught me how to deal with it. Highly recommend, except for the fact that a lot of the content they've been pushing lately has been highly identity based, which...seems to run counter to the whole idea of being able to let go of all that in order to just be present. It limits who I can recommend it too, which is unfortunate.

Originally gave the app 5 stars, now 4 because the UI has become more difficult to navigate. I was attempting to recommend the app to a friend last night and could not find my buddy link (although I could "change it") or any other type of sharing link. I find myself using less of the app overall now that there are so many different things to do with the app. Great product still but it's become less intuitive.

Canceled the subscription in the app and received a confirmation email that said I would not be charged this month. To my surprise, I just saw that I was billed again this month despite what the email had said. Too often, once some these apps get your credit card number, they make it impossible to cancel. I thought this was a reputable app/business/company, but they are just scammers like so many others! Utterly disappointing!
I can’t do anything without a membership that cost money! I would just rather use a white noise app.
I used to have the basics for free now everything costs money ??? another money hungry developers claiming to help you with mediation when there are better and green methods out there don’t buy
The only reason I downloaded this crap was for the free falling back to sleep quick meditation, but of course their cheap asses make you pay now. THANKS ALOT👎👎👎

I had so much hope downloading this app. The only good, free thing about this gimmicky app is the stress/anxiety tracker. B even then, why do I care how stressful I have been throughout the week? Completely irrelevant to me. EVERYTHING requires a membership that is overpriced. And the free trial? Only 7 days. Spotify is more generous and gives you a month, but no. You can only have a week, because these developers are cheapskates. Take my advice, don’t download this. Invest your time and device’s space on an actually useful meditation app.
I have found the breathing guidance and intro into meditating very peaceful. Well done!

opened the app because i wanted to try meditation and find a way to calm down at night. i could not find a single thing that i didn’t need to start a free trial and subscribe for. there should be free options for those that do not have the money.
Really? Charging users an arm and a leg for simple meditation? Not everyone has $20 to throw out every month, and almost everything has a pay block infront of it. Mental health matters.

There seems to be nothing you can use the app for unless you pay for a subscription. It's one of the most expensive subscriptions available. There are several other options you can subscribe to at the same time, and still have change left over when compared to a single subscription to this app. This app has to be one of the worst value apps on the play store. One star is far too generous for this app, as far as value is concerned. Look elsewhere, there are far better apps.

I've loved this for a long time but it has been terribly buggy as of late. I can't even sign in! I try connecting through my Google Account which is how I signed AND have my subscription for (as in, paying money) and an error pops up saying that "it look like that email already has an account attached to it." Like are you serious! Any subscription service that doesn't work should be required by law to give immediate refunds regardless if the user wants to continue with the product or not.

App keeps crashing after 5 minutes whatever I play, even restarted phone to trouble shoot, still crashing. So frustrating when you need to relax and actually getting more agitated with this happening. I love this app, so please fix asap.

Buggy. Sometimes I'll finish a session in a course, but the app won't update the progress in the course. Since I can't skip sessions, I can't progress. Seriously, how hard can it possibly be to get this to work right? Just playback audio tracks with a bit of conditional logic to sting things together. If your devs can't fix this, then at least give me the option to progress without your management getting in the way.

I have been using this App for a couple of years but I haven't use it in a long time. I decided to pay another annual subscription fee about a week ago, but the app won't unlock the meditations. It keeps telling me to start a free trial, then a message pops up and tells me that I already have a subscription, but it never unlocks anything. I have uninstalled several times and it's keeps doing the same thing. I can't even get any tech support. THIS IS CAUSING ME MORE STRESS!!
everything is locked so you have to pay

This used to be one of the best meditation apps, and I’m sure it is still really good. It’s just a shame that you have to pay to use anything on there now. There used to be quite a bit of meditations you could still do without having to pay but now there’s nothing. They could have left some things open for those who don’t have a lot of money to be spending on apps but still need to reap the benefits of guided meditation. I’m not asking for a lot, just for a couple of basic meditations to be left open to non-paying users. That would also help people figure out if this is the right app for them before committing. I understand there is a free trial, but I don’t like the idea of handing over credit card information prior to knowing if one will actually enjoy the app.

Cannot Cancel the subscription through app, need to visit desktop site to cancel. If you can allow subscribtion through app you can easily provide cancel option in mobile. It's just a SCAM and LOOT people, so that people can forget to subscribe even if they don't want to continue. Cancellation should be as easy as subscription, actually even easier as it doesn't involve any payment. And no, I will not send an e-mail to address my concern. Anything you have to say, you an say here.

After coming back to this app at a time of need again i find that the basic free account is no longer available and everything is locked. Free trials are great but having a few basic things open without the stress of looming payment after 7 days should be available. Self care has become so expensive now. Apart from this its still a great app

Hey so you know how some things are free? Couldn't access them without signing up for the 14 day free trial. So I did that, immediately canceled the subscription because I don't want the full version and just wanted access to the like, two free sleep stories on the app, and immediately got charged the full 69.98?? I want my money back. I like the meditations and was wanting to get the full version again someday but this is scummy.

Sleepcasts continue to stop even with subscriptions! I only pay for it for the Sleepcasts to fall asleep. Right when you get to the "whine down" the app stops playing. I've tried on multiple phones and does the same thing. Honestly, I keep seeing "be patient while we sort this out" from the reviews but if that's the case then don't charge the users reporting the problems. Very frustrating! Looking for another app since HeadSpace is a waste when the one thing I use it for no longer works!!!

reviews.t: You need money to be happy
reviews.x: I understand wanting to make a premium feature, make money off the app, but to make almost EVERY SINGLE OPTION a premium feature limits the amount of people you’re going to have actually being able to use your app. either make more free, or add a more accessible free option.

reviews.t: Beautiful meditation guides, but why so expensive?
reviews.x: I’m really disappointed with how expensive Headspace still is. If the creators’ values were about helping people, I’m confused as to why they still charge people $17/month? Headspace makes over $100 million in revenue every year…

I used to have this app about 2 or 3 years ago and it literally got worse. There was only one sleep sound open and now they want you to buy EVERYTHING. You can’t do anything unless you pay. There using people with mental issues and making them pay for crap like this. I would NEVER recommend this app to anyone. If I could I would give no stars.

I loved the free portion of this app. I told myself if I used it often enough, I'd like to subscribe. But I was a student and couldn't afford it. One day I felt I needed this apps help again, and looked for the free sleep casts at 4am on a night I couldn't sleep just to find that it was all locked behind a pay wall now. For something I use once in a few months, I'm not paying a yearly or even monthly sub. I did really like this app. Please give back the free casts.

I used to use the free portion of this app, but now it's all paid, so I sucked it up and subscribed because it was helpful to wind down at night to sleep. Now that my free trail period is over, the sleepcasts have been timing out every few minutes when my phone screen locks. It's counter-productive to have to pick up your phone every 3-5 mins to use the app. I'm not happy I paid for a whole year. It seems others are having this issue too and I don't see any comments about a fix in the works.
Don’t download this app unless you are ready to pay monthly to access anything. It looks beautiful if you can afford it, but it’s a shame a “mindfulness” app charges it’s customers.

I used to use this app and not pay the subscription. I was happy to listen to the same sleep podcast every night.... I just downloaded the app again today, I can't find a single thing that is free to listen to, not even a 3 minute episode, everything is locked now and I'm not in a position to pay that much for a subscription. I wish there was a fee things I could listen to so that could tell if it's worth paying.
Did u seriously just take away all free sleepcasts? Great, thanks. Now I can’t fall asleep unless I want to spend $20 as a student already struggling to afford groceries. Ridiculous.
this app used to have several free episodes that i would listen to and i loved it. now everything is locked and have to pay
everything in this app costs money, not everybody has this kind of money to pay EVERY MONTH.

I've enjoyed the apps commercials and was considering buying it. I read a review that mentioned that complete access to the app is subscription based and not a one time purchase. I haven't bothered reviewing the rates. I have habitual usage of the same apps over the years and I can't imagine how broke I'd be if I paid monthly/yearly subscriptions to use them. I've seen reviews stating that it used to be more accesible, so changing now to require subscription is a complete money grab.

I'd rank the app higher if it didn't start shoving everything that used to be available for free behind a paywall. The basics at the very least should be readily available to newcomers, but you need to set up your card info just to access the basics now. I'd been using the app for about 2 years before this, so it's a little disappointing because it's the only real problem I have with the app.

The listing doesn't show the subscription cost. I installed it, thinking if it was a few bucks a month I might give it a try. I was astounded to find out it was $17.99 a month! (If you commit to a full year, you get a savings so it is only (only!) $7.50 a month, $89.99 for the year. It is all the more galling that they want that kind of money, and the don't even provide a free lesson, or even a small sample just to hear the quality of the recording. Uninstalled!

Personaly, I really like the format of the app and the idea. However, I am not fond of the choice to have a lack of free available options. I downloaded to app expecting it to be a good thing for my mental health. If I can barely pay rent, how am I supposed to pay extra for my MENTAL HEALTH! If your going to create an app designed to help you mentaly, the least you could do is make more than 1 program that is free. If you were to do that, i could actually improve mentaly. I have bad anxiety. Ugh

This app just doesn't do it anymore. Used to have the subscription, wouldnt do it again based off the look of the app and changes made. The app is indeed free: to download and see a lock icon on everything, that is. We could complain about it being in the free category but it's no different than the Netflix app when you think about it. Just make it more clear and there probably wouldn't be so many negative reviews about people being disappointed. You save a lot of time, yours and the user.

Pretty disappointing. I loved the few things that were available on here for free. I cant afford a subscription when I can hardly pay my bills. Naively, I thought the whole "headspace" stuff was a company that genuinely wanted to work with the public for better mental health. Lol I was wrong. It's about hopping on a trend and making as much money as they can. Not a single thing is free anymore. Disgusted.

This app has made such a positive difference in my life. I'm so thankful to have access to it. I may send this to their contact email, but I sometimes find myself wanting to go through their meditation singles or courses with more options. For example, I generally find having a voice reminding me to go back to the breath to be too distracting. It would be nice to be able to just have a soft bell or turn it off entirely and go unguided (like in the pro sessions).

I used to use headspace EVERYDAY multiple times a day. Phenomenal app. I paid for the year. However, before it became so popular, there were a decent amount of meditations on the app, that you could practice without a need to pay. I thought that was great bc clearly a good majority of the population was/is going through it. Now I'm at a time of need mentally and go back to what got me through my roughest times just for ALL of them to require a subscription now. 😔

If you're looking for a quick guided meditation to supplement your normal sessions rarely, this is apparently no longer the app to use. I'm not against paying for a service you like, but there is officially NOTHING free on the app, and it doesn't advertise that until you spend time digging around wondering why everything, literally everything including the one minute "3 breaths" exercise requires a subscription. Just make it a paid app now so people know what they're getting into.

Used to use this app literally every night of my life. Used the same little sound called "doze" as it was I believe the only free one. Now they want a minimum of 6 dollars a month to listen it. Every other aspect of the app was paid already but now they went and took away the one free thing. Very very disappointing. Will be sadly deleting the app.

I used this app for one thing only and one of the very few free features left. I liked to listen to the sleep music "Doze" most nights to fall asleep. I went in to the app today and it's been locked for access unless you have a paid subscription. What a huge disappointment and just another money grab from the company. The app is no longer free in any sense and I've deleted it permanently.

HORRIBLE, CAN'T USE ANYTHING UNLESS YOU PAY!! I don't have the subscription so I'd just use the free items they had. I just used the Basics to meditate everyday, but I go on it today and now that's also locked and I have to pay a subscription to use that!! It's unbelievable. This app was really amazing when you didn't have to pay for literally EVERYTHING!!

I have been using this app for a while and really enjoyed using the basic portion. I only need it for sleeping as I have insomnia and also cannot sleep without certain sounds. Tonight as I went to play the ONLY sound I've used (rain - called "antiques"), I've found that EVERYTHING is under subscription, so I've deleted the app. I don't need all of the sounds, just that one, and I think it's unfair to make me pay for a whole app for one sound.

You can't listen to anything now without signing up for a free trial then having to remember to cancel it. It's pretty expensive too. No warning, they just changed it overnight. I was only using this for sleep so can't justify the cost. Last night I listened to rainday antiques, tonight they've made it so nothing is available to even try. I'm not happy and will be uninstalling immediately. There are other apps I can use for sleep.

Tbh when I was using it before there were several free features that were really helpful when I was having a panic attack, but now it won't even let me check my account details. I just get spammed with "premium" ads. It's not premium if you have to pay for the whole app. That's just a very expensive paid app. Premium suggests that there is some - however limited - access for the free download. Whereas I can't get past the cycle of three pages telling me to pay a yearly fee.

If it isn't free, I wish it was upfront about that from the beginning. Not only is it completely not free, it's actually quite pricy. Maybe worth the cost, if you are interested in paying a monthly fee for this, but I'm subscribed to so many subscriptions at this point, I really shouldn't be adding more. I would have known to pass on the app if I had known this one is only usable if you are willing to subscribe. Their lack of transparency is a massive issue to me.

reviews.t: They sit on a throne of LIES!
reviews.x: I downloaded this app for the sleep features. I fully expected a lot of things to be behind the subscriber paywall. But there is ZERO free content to be had. Apple should NOT be allowing companies to advertise a “free app with optional in-app purchases” if the app is literally unusable without paying.

Don't list sleepcasts as 45 minutes long when they're 25 minutes of talking and 20 minutes of ambience. I would KILL to be able to put these sleepcasts on repeat, with no extended ambience. The slider is great. If someone wanted ambience, they could use the slider and put it on repeat. So there's no need for the extended ambience. It's like falling sleep in the car, only to be woken up when the car comes to a stop. It's pointless. Other than that, I love the app. It's helped my sleep a lot.

Worth every penny! A year's subscription is cheaper than one therapy session, and equally helpful. So beneficial if you are stressed, anxious, mourning, having trouble sleeping, etc.--there are guided meditations for an array of situations, with calm-voiced guidance (& I appreciate that you can choose male or female narrator), and wonderful mini animated lessons that help concepts stick in my head.
Not everyone has money to. Spend people need that for food and everything
I used this app years ago and loved it! But now you need a trial for everything a lot of my family and friends have gotten ridden of the app for this problem please unlock stuff ty!
You get 3 free meditations and you have to pay for the rest

I figured I would try the app to see if they have a few free things, but sadly everything on app is locked. And I don't like putting in my card information for a free trial, just because I've had bad experiences with trying to cancel. I don't have any insight about the app since I haven't used it but I am going to stick with the Netflix series I have been using(which is what got me interested in app in the first place). If you dont mind paying for a subscription I'm sure their content is good.
literally everything is locked

The whole concept and clean absolutely amazing organization for the app makes me want to try it to an extreme amount but, as alot of the other reviews say, you should have free options. Theres no need to charge people that much when we have youtube and other free apps.
didn’t know i had to pay to try and have a peaceful sleep

I love the content. I have used this app for many years and done a lot of meditations and courses and been a subscriber on and off. But it really bothers me how the subscription is managed now. There is no free content. They make false statements about a free trial: if you used one years ago then it is still advertiesed when you make a new subscription even though you are not eligible. Its very complicated to cancel the subscription. All in all it feels like they want to trap you.

I was using the app for the free courses, The Basics, while I learn the practice. And now they're locked suddenly and there is no more free content at all. I was learning a lot with those courses and feel like they need to be free. As a new meditator, I don't want to purchase the whole library when I'm just a beginner. I planned on purchasing later as I progressed, but now I'll have to find a new app to practice on... :(

I was unexpectedly charged with a year's subscription and was told I was getting two weeks free before they charged. That was a lie man. $75 later and my bank account is empty. The whole reason I decided that was fine was I was getting paid again in two weeks. I'd really prefer a refund as I don't even have the app. I love their content their app just isn't worth it when you get it with Netflix. Even if I had used my two weeks before this time around they should tell you. Can't even eat now.

It was really a good app, but when you removed Sleeping wind downs from free, it gets useless for me. It was such a incredible session. It doesn't make sense if you keep Falling back to sleep for free but don't keep Sleeping. I miss the time when everything was not about money, really good time. reviews.t: Headspace’s inability to name anti-Black racism and police brutality
reviews.x: Headspace just released a session focused on “mindfulness in the face of injustice,” in response to recent events in the US. In the resultant “lesson,” the narrator refuses to even say the words racism, police brutality, anti-Black discrimination, etc. Instead, he speaks to concerns people may have of protests turning violent - without even acknowledging the fear and exasperation underlying the protests in the first place. I understand that Headspace has a broad viewership, but if it’s not prepared to name racism, it is inappropriate to profit off this moment of pain by sanitizing it and bringing it up as a “lesson.” Headspace could be a really powerful tool for equipping people with the skills to listen deeply and engage with hard conversations about race, which which provoke intense emotional reactions in people. As a white person, I wish I had more mindfulness tools to engage in this work of unpacking privilege and acknowledging harm. But unfortunately, Headspace has not yet proven to be a platform that enables this important work.

Uninstalled, then tried signing up the regular way -> says account already created. Tried logging in -> incorrect password. Tried "Forgot Password" -> gives me an error. Too stressful for an app that's supposed to help you calm down.

I'm enjoying it so far. The structure is much needed by me. One small issue so far. I am doing the Stress pack. I've found a few times that when I select a certain session length, the version that loads is incorrect timewise. E.g. a ten min session ran for 20 mins plus the preamble, and I was nearly late for work. Just now I selected 20 mins and it only ran to 10.

Extremely useful tool for beginners as well as more experienced meditators. Surprised at how much content there is for free- I got a yearly subscription and you have access to much more. Gives you an extra push when you don't feel like sitting. The only thing I would like is if you could keep a journal after each meditation so that you can note any particular experiences or lessons you learned. Otherwise it seems less like a journey since you can't really keep a record of your unique experience

This app is great. They have a variety of meditations to choose from and of differing lengths. I bought it while it was 40% off so not a bad deal. I love how it provides advice as well as meditation in the form of little cartoons sometimes. Very helpful. I personally find Andy Puddicombe to have a very soothing voice and really enjoy his backstory as a Westerner who became a monk for ten years. I think that shows in the explanations they offer. They make it more accessible to beginners.

So the issue isn't that it's free, if it was an app you had to pay for that won't be an issue either. The issue is that they let you download a free app where 90% of the content is behind a paywall. Instead of letting me waste time and data downloading your app to realize it's mostly in app purchases just put a price on the thing. If it's a marketing strategy then rather release a demo version

I love the guided meditations, but PLEASE add more unsubscribed meditations! I remember when there was no subscription, but now you almost can't do ANYTHING without paying. I'm fine with the 100$ a year thing (that's not a lot!) but there needs to be more meditations for the people that aren't willing or can't pay. Or maybe you could add some ads? Love the meditations, hate the lack of them.

I really enjoyed this, it was helping get to sleep faster than I've ever been to but it cut me off after a few days demanding money. I used one or two of the sleep mediations, not any of the other services. I really wish there was a free option offered. Preferably with no ads. As a college student with very limited funds, I liked the rest I got, but not the price.

Paid for a year about 11 months ago and used this app daily on my iPhone. It was a great experience, I loved the content & would renew in a heartbeat. But I recently switched to Android and now getting the same issues as everyone else has. It will either freeze or audio stops working on my Bluetooth headphones. This NEVER happened on the iPhone. I've signed out & signed back in. I've uninstalled & reinstalled. Still no improvement. I won't renew if you don't fix this.

Its is good app though rather expensive. I played for a yearly subscription though as I love the sleep casts. However recently I have been having the same problem as many others where sleepcasts and meditations keep stopping every minute or so, making it very hard to sleep and relax with constant interruptions. I have tried uninstalling and reinstalling but it did nothing. Please work on fixing this ASAP as I can no longer use the app and has been a waste of my money. Thank you.

I love the animations, the different "themed" packages/session types are awesome. This app is laid out brilliantly, and I like that everything has a "high end" feel--as far as the branding and presentation--If there were different pricing options I would give it 5 stars. I just don't like having ONE choice of payment. What if I want to purchase a single pack at a time? It appears that many others here have similar thoughts. Regardless, thank you for such a great app; I appreciate your work!

The content is great, but the price is horrible for what it is. 95% of it is behind a monthly paywall. It could've been acceptable for a one-time payment, but nope, you're forced to pay just as much than some other subscriptions that give so much more. It sure doesn't give a "peace of mind" on the wallet. Update: Down a star now as the app suddenly loses connection within the first minute of sleepcasts for no reason; my internet have no issues. I'm officially switching to a different app now.

I downloaded this from a good old YouTube ad and was disappointed to find out that pretty much everything requires an expensive subscription. After looking into it, supposedly there are some free items, but everything I saw was paid only. The app seems lovely, but I wish it had been clear before downloading and creating the required account that I would need a subscription to use the app. It was never noted until I got to the content, unlike most apps, which straightforwardly tell you up front.

really, this is a great app. the meditations are really good and helpful, there’s a wide variety, and for many different reasons but why is it so expensive? not everyone has the income to spend $17.99 a MONTH on meditations. also, there is a very limited amount of meditations available for free members. if you could lower the price to maybe $10 a month, max, and widen the variety of options available for free user, you may have more people willing to buy premium. or, even better, you could make all of them available for free, but a premium version available as well to remove ads or be able to download meditations, etc., because i understand that you must be able to make money from this application. i just think almost twenty dollars a month is an extravagant amount to pay for an app that isn’t even catered towards the user specifically, especially when there are many users that cannot afford such pricey mental health care. basically, the app is really well made with many quality meditations but premium is simply way too overpriced.

This app was fabulous for my first year. Now, it just doesn't seem to work smoothly at all. Sessions stop abruptly in the middle and there's no way to redownload them. Downloaded sessions say they're available offline but don't play or cut off in the middle. I have re-installed the app a dozen times, sent info to support for investigation with no improvement, and even tried to stream from the website ... all are choppy and unreliable now. Not sure what changed but it's so disappointing.

App functions well, but you will get harrassed by their constant marketing. You're just a revenue upsell source, not a customer. I love the idea of this service, and the topic seems to be implemented well. However they defeat the purpose of an app to reduce stress by then constantly bombarding you every day with intrusive and invasive upsell notifications, even after you mark in the settings not to notify you. Unfortunately the only 'leave me alone' button I could find is named 'uninstall'...

The app itself is good, and the meditation techniques work. However, as more time passes with the app, the numver of things you can do without the subscription decrease. I was using the sleepcasts to get to sleep, and now due to them being added to the pot of things you need to subscribe for, I have been left without a way of getting to sleep.

I have the annual subscription, the meditations are good but notifications are anxiety inducing so I turned them off. I don't need to be reminded 5 times a day to meditate and that I'm going to die one day. I'm taking a break for a bit because I wasn't really feeling any benefits, the sleep podcasts are nice but they seem to end the narrative abruptly.

I find the app itself is worth every penny. The free Basics course has a lot of great information to get you started meditating. There are meditations on all types of subjects, from short SOS types to longer courses. The courses can seem repetitive at first, but as with any new skill, it takes practice to master. Stick with it - they do evolve and introduce new skills. With regular practice I've noticed a world of difference in my mood and how I handle difficult emotions.

I really love this app and the meditations are really helping calming the mind. However, when I first installed it, there was a lot of free contents, which I was happy with. Now, there is almost nothing (if you don't want to pay the monthly subscription). Sadly, as I don't find Headspace worth to have on my phone anymore, I'm going to uninstall the app.

The selection is wonderful, the content is life-changing; however the tech-side could be improved. While commuting, which is usually the best time for me to use the app, I'm often switching between signal and no signal. This transition is often difficult, despite pre-downloading the sessions and causes the audio to end abruptly while the app thinks it's still playing. Moreover, I regularly have to re-download the same session even after selecting the Download option, wasting a lot of data.

Couldn't even sign up. I tried to sign up with email and I got a "something went wrong" notification. I thought maybe I had signed up before and just didn't recall, so I tried to sign in. Got another error message. Tried to reset my password, got another error message. I don't have Facebook to log in with, so I guess I just don't get to use the app.

I just finished the first 10-day basics course and am loving it. First time trying meditation and I can definitely see some differences throughout my day - more presence of mind and awareness. The lessons are very easy to follow, well explained, and the male voice is so soothing! 5⭐ I compared it to Calm, and while I found both to be good, Calm ends up doing IMHO too much and gets distracting. I like the fact that Headspace is focused and that every time I open it there are no distractions.

Try the free lessons and if you REALLY like his voice, presentation style and technique then it might be worth it for you, but personally I found it prohibitive and distracting. The monthly paywall is pretty aggressive to imo, and the advertising targeting mental heath is misleading and disappointing. That said it could be the perfect meditation app for some.

Great app. It's easy to use and very helpful. I have one complaint however, don't worry it's nothing major. You could view it as me simply whining, but I wish that a little more things were free on the app. I understand that they want to produce profit, but there's only three available sleep podcasts. Which are all very helpful, and I would absolutely recommend this app to anyone who has problems falling asleep like I do! But it can get a little repetitive at times. Otherwise a wonderful app.

So much more than a meditation session. Purchasing the yearly subscription was the best decision I have made this year. (I used to have the free version). From amazing sleep podcasts, to eating habits, to dealing with anxiety and sadness, and anger management, this app helps me think more clearly and help relieve some of the horrible daily habits I used to have. There's nothing more important than your mental health.

I used to take hours to fall asleep, but with the sleep casts I fell asleep within 5 minutes. It used to be great, but now they have locked and it will only allow me one free female sleep cast, and I cant sleep with the Male, and I cant use the same one every night. The only way to unlock the rest is with a subscription, but they are outrageously priced! I would get a subscription and it would help my health so much if it was cheaper. I would also love more female sleep casts. I am disappointed.

Downloaded this thinking it might be a good way to unwind after a long day, but very disappointed. I start the app and am immediately asked to sign in, then asked to set a daily reminder time (which seemed unavoidable despite my not wanting to commit to something consistent), and then asked to pay a monthly subscription to access the 'full library'. Promptly uninstalled as felt too invasive for this kind of app. Disappointing given how well-praised this app apparently is!

Good for meditation, not so much sleeping unless you'd like to pay for it which I will do once I have money to spend on apps. It would be nice if you could at least try one podcast before choosing to unlock the others but other than that, pretty decent app and the voices are soothing. I appreciate the bedtime notification because I have problems with staying up late.

I really enjoyed this app, mostly for the sleep casts which were a huge help for my insomnia, but since the update I no longer have access to the sleep casts unless I pay for a subscription which isn't cheap. Now the app is basically useless to me as most of the features I enjoyed as a feee user have been restricted to a paid subscription. It looks like I'm not the only one. It also sticks out to me that they have such an insincere auto response to anyone upset with the change. Disgraceful.

This is a money grab, and used against people who have mental health issues, it is unacceptable that the prices for these sounds are so astronomically high. Some people are actually struggling, the prices are sickening.

very effective but very expensive. I would watch ads if it meant 90% of their content wasn't behind a 100$ paywall. genuinely good content when you can acess it, but that's not often. you get like, one wind down, one ambient noise track, the basics, and that's it. kinda frustrating, especially because i know it works. id probably pay a one time fee for this, it's really worth it, but 100 dollars a year? no way.

This is the first meditation app I've tried and I see no reason to try anything else! I love the animations of what's going on in the mind when we worry, or try to find happiness and they are used sparingly and only when needed for a particular lesson. I find both voices to be pleasant and calm, not droning or flat. As you progress, the silence between speaking parts gets longer and longer, but I never really noticed a difference in my perception of time from the 5 minute to 10 minute lessons!

This app is way too expensive. For a company to charge people for an app is ridiculous. They will not be making anything from me. Try $5 subscription a month and you’ll have more people interested. This is not specifically catered for me so why should I spend so much.
I used this app for the 10 days that I had the free basics meditation. It was extremely helpful, but it is so expensive to continue.

The app is kind of misleading. Even though it’s a free app you barely get any of the options for free. I wanted to use the app to help me sleep, and I think I had two or so free options of each category otherwise I had to pay for the subscription. If I could afford the subscription I would probably do it, but I just think the app should have more options available without paying. From the few things I did try out, it seems like a cool idea.

Your subscription prices are out of control, they used to be less. They are double the price of other good meditation apps like calm. I was considering switching over from calm this year but the pricing is extremely hard to justify paying twice as much. Plus there’s no girl voice, only on basic course. Plus there’s no optional music. How can you demand twice as much money with half as many features as calm?

The sleep casts are amazing and I've had no troubles getting to sleep since I've been listening to them (there's tons of different ones). The reminder of when I should get to sleep to get 8 hours of it is very helpful as well. I haven't used the app for meditation but that would be the only thing I'd critique it on, as it only gives you three free lessons but from then on you need to pay. I'd be fine for paying for the full app if it wasn't so expensive, other then that it's amazing!

This app is really soothing, and I mainly use it for the sleep casts, but it really needs to be updated more. please add more sleep casts more often. Even though they are a little different each night, I still get bored of the same ones. Edit: So instead of adding MORE sleepcasts, you take them away?!?! What kind of answer to my request is that?!?!

The meditation itself is fantastic, however the trial is not long enough for me to determine if this is really worth my money to subscribe for the full features. In addition to this they only provide two subscription options yearly or monthly. If only there was a 3 or 6 month option. It takes 30 consecutive days to create a habit but it takes even longer to make it a permanent part of your routine. 3 months is adequate time for me to determine if it can be integrated into my routine.

I was super excited to try this free meditation app: that I had seen an advertisement for. Seemed like a good and easy way to learn how to balance myself with my busy schedual. But low and behold its not free. The only free things about this app are the beginner meditation courses. I was and still am disappointed with the false advertisement. If it was cheaper or free would give higher then a 2 star rating.

great app, love the set up and narration. I used to use it all the time but the update made it so less stuff was available without subscription. Can you please bring back the sleep ambience without subscription? I can’t afford premium but the sleep tracks really helped me with anxiety and stuff

Being a university student, I am the perfect vessel for uncontrollable stress. This application, didn’t eliminate all my stress, however instead, it helped me reduce it. Headspace gives you the starting point for daily self-mediation sessions. Breathing exercises, calming voice overs, and many more. I would highly recommend this App to anyone suffering with anxiety, or stress, this is a good starting point to find clarity for your mind.

Headspace has been a real bubble of oxygen in my life. Before that I couldn't even enjoy a movie of a book, because my mind was spinning . Now I can, and I do with much pleasure. But of course, that's not it. It took several hours for me to sleep. Now barely a few minutes. Headspace has brought me so much more. I prefer the organization of the old version it was much clearer. This one is so messy the courses, singles and animations are completely blended and you struggle to find anything...

decent app, but way overpriced for the content (or lack thereof). I mean, most of what we pay for on this is silence--why does it cost nearly as much as my spotify or netflix subscription? this kind of racket makes me long for the days of CDs. i enjoyed my stay, but am moving to more reasonably priced alternatives.

Solid content. Unfortunately the app doesn't allow you to manage downloaded meditations easily, or to save favorites. Maybe it's because I don't want to watch The Basics and that feature will be exposed later? Also, because the marketing vids (only got the app when recommended by a friend, not the incessant ads) used one of the male voices, it's hard to relax listening to that voice as it represents wanting an ad to finish in my mind.

The app is not bad, however after sometime, in more advanced courses it turns out to fail quite often which does not help when you are trying to get rid of thoughts, as you end up wondering if it will fail again to let you know when the 20 minutes have finished. Because of that and the fact that other apps are cheaper, I didn´t want to renew it, however they renewed it without notice and when I asked for a refund and cancellation 25 days after the renewal, they told me that the 30 days cancellation policy only applies to the initial service. I would have come back, perhaps, but definitely not now about this bad customer service.

I bought it for one month and really like it. I would have committed for a year, but since you can't sign up for a year and pay the lesser price monthly, I would have. I can't afford 95.00 all at once and 12.99 a month is way too much. so, I will go use a lesser priced second fave. if you have the funds to purchase the year, please do it, you will enjoy it!

I have major depression and extreme anxiety. It causes me to toss and turn while sleeping, getting only 3-5 hours of sleep a night. I used this app just once, doing the 10 minute session and a bed time story. I passed out within 4 minutes of the story and stayed asleep all night. I listen to a session at least 3 times a day. It has made me feel little to no anxiety and my depression is always away as long as I keep listening daily. This app is wonderful! It's also helped me quit smoking.

Headspace is great for basics, but when andy says, "let it go". it's very vague. i don't know what letting go means. i have used this app for almost 2 years but my anxiety wasn't improving. The audios don't actually help me with how to control my emotions. i realized that while meditating i was suppressing my thoughts and emotions because i didn't know what letting go really means. i think you guys should take a more practical approach like that of joseph Goldstein.

A great app! I use the SleepCasts each night to calm anxious thoughts so I can fall asleep and fall back asleep when I wake up in the night. I would love for more of them to be added to the library as I have listened to each one multiple times in the last month. I also would love for listening to SleepCasts to count towards meditation minutes! Those two changes would have me leaving a 5 star review.

The meditation here is definitely very effective, to the point where I was literally laughing afterwards. However, the subscription is so ridiculously priced that I simply cannot afford it. Do NOT try this app if you can't afford the subscription as you will feel like your day is missing something without meditating. It would be good if each individual pack could be bought and kept for £5 or so rather than paying an extortionate price for all the sessions I'll probably never do.

After you've finished basics, it basically shows you that there's no other option but to subscribe. The basics lessons disappear. Unless I can be told where I can find the baud sessions to remind myself than I'm keeping this so at 1 star. I don't have money to spend and you'd think that people who know how important mindfulness is, that they'd at least keep one program free for people. This app is only good for two weeks than it's useless.

To start off this concept is great. the problem is you have to pay a subscription after the first 3 introduction meditations. You also dont get to pick what they are. which is just a general meditation. if it actually had more of a free section followed with advanced premium section would make more sense. maybe when i have money to spare ill check into it further.

I was pleasantly surprised at the amount of focus and calm I gained from this app. I've always known meditation is important, but this is the first time I've been able to be consistent in my practice due to the reminders and ease of use. There's seemingly a meditation for everything ranging from stress, focus, eating, walking, anger, and even studying! 3 minute meditations work perfect for my busy schedule and I can't emphasize enough how much this has improved my daily life. I feel at ease.

I truly adore the app, however, I wish it was cheaper. I am a student who finds the app very helpful but I cannot afford the monthly fee... It is a little bit too expensive (at least in Poland). It is disheartening because you guys could help so many people who are struggling with mental health issues or are simply afraid to take part in psychotherapy etc. Or at least there could be an option to buy single courses.

Far too little content for free users. If you are not paying for the subscription the app is not worth it. The app is cluttered and pretty difficult to navigate, I was constantly getting frustrated with the layout. It is a shame, a good app with plenty of free meditations and less cluttered navigation would be a huge game changer for me, and probably a lot of other people.

The amount of times I get this app forced down my throat while watching YouTube, I was thoroughly disappointed when I realised it was subscription based. I did not purchase any subscription. Not because it was overly expensive, but it was definitely more than I would be willing to pay, and after seeing what is actually available without having to pay for anything, I feel like I should be monetarily compensated for this inconvenience. Once again, thoroughly disappointed.

I downloaded the app and used the free trial, really enjoyed it. Loved the mindful videos and the meditations were great. My issue comes in with the cost after the trial per month. $10 a month is almost the same as the monthly charge for Netflix or Spotify which get used a heck of a lot more for me. I wish there were different levels/options that were more affordable so mental health is more accessible for more users. It would also be nice to have the option of a different instructor voice

I personally love the idea of having so much access to a wide array of audio tutorials for meditation. However, what I don't love so much, is the subscription system. I feel it's somewhat of a ripoff to have most of the app locked off unless a fee is paid every month, especially with the lessons. I feel that it would be fair to use a subscription to access multiple lessons at a time, but at least let people do another lesson if they aren't already doing a lesson.

The app frequently crashes and overall feels a little clunky. I've been using the paid version for about a month and there have already been a few times when a mediation stops on me which is especially frustrating during a silent spot because you're while you're trying to focus and meditate you have to wonder if the app crapped out. It becomes the source of distracting thoughts you're trying to prevent. I stream audio through other music and podcast apps without issue. Not worth the $$$

I absolutely loved this app, I used it every day, eventually subscribed, told all of my friends. Then all of a sudden there was some sort of update so now it's telling me to subscribe all over again even though I just did a week ago, and it was taken out of my account. I've tried to hit the 'restore purchase'. So I was like ya know what maybe some how it was an error on my part I'll just buy it again, kicker is; it would let me. Keeps saying I already have a subscription, seriou
It’s 2019 it’s absurd to charge these kinds of prices for someone’s mental health and well being. In an age where resources are made available via things like YouTube. Thank U, Next 🤦🏻‍♀️

To be honest, I'm not sure why this up is so successful. It seems more like marketing gimmick like those games u always see on Instagram rather than a decent meditation app. It's basically useless unless you pay for a subscription and if you do pay your just getting what a lot of other apps give you for free. You really don't need this to meditate or practice mindfulness, it may actually just make it more of a process. But if you want to follow the crowd, then go for it!

I really enjoyed this app for the sleepcasts and it was helping me keep a good routine during my semester so far. At first I could access some content for free until it disabled all content unless I paid an unreasonable amount for a subscription. Very disappointing. I probably would have paid for access to more of the app later but now I'm uninstalling.

I have been using the app for free on and off the the past year and i finally got through the basics class and subscribed to the full app. I can't wait to keep using it. It would be nice if everything was downloadable as i don't always have internet and very limited data. It would also be nice to be able to star or favorite some of the single meditations that i want quick access to. thank you.

The free version is absolutely worth your time and feels complete -- no cliffhangers where you have to pay to finish what you started. With that said, I find the full paid subscription to be worth the cost. There is a deep variety of tracks like pain management, sports training, business travel, panic/SOS, kids tracks and lots of sleep aid option (with wake-up too!), and more. The overall positivity of the founder conveys through each lesson though he has brought-in other voices now.

I was going to wait a while longer to give a review but after reading the 1 stars I felt something needed to be said. People complain about the price but the alternative to a subscription is ads everywhere. If the app stops working, email the help line and ask them to sort it out for you (they seem more than willing to help every customer... subscription or not). Regardless of what people say, this app kills my anxiety and the developers should be so proud. 5 stars always!

It looks wonderful, but I wish there were other teachers. If you could pay for what you need individually, as some kind of one time fee, that would be great. The only thing I pay that much for is Adobe CC, which I use for work and have a student discount for (only $2 more than this app). You can't put a price on mental health but I don't see this being a similar value considering I get so many apps with CC. Also, I don't like having to create a new account before I even use an app.

Dont get me wrong, this app used to be awesome. There are tons of great guided meditations (even short ones for busy people). I joined headspace years back when it first came out and I loved it! There were a couple sessions that you had to pay for and I didnt mind that. BUT NOW I cannot access a single session without being a monthly subscriber, unnecessary as I only use the app every now and then. What a bummer!

There is so little content that is available for free that it is absolutely not worth downloading this app unless you are willing to pay their sky high subscription price of $13 a month--which I, for one, am not. It's guided meditation, and in my opinion nothing about it sets it apart enough in quality or otherwise from the thousands of free guided meditations on YouTube and other platforms. A waste of my time.
Awesome app to relax just wish to have the other things that we have to unlock without payment

Absolutely love this app! It's the only way I've ever been able to meditate. To make it even better, it'd be nice if there was a search bar of some sorts. I know everything is organized in categories, but I find it a bit stressful having to go through those sections in order to see if the app has what I'm looking for. Also, it'd be such a plus if there were single meditations for sadness, depression, insomnia (there are 3 or 4 that focus on getting you to sleep, but... none of them is specific for this. I'd also include a pack about it) and periods (there's a meditation that walks you through physical pain. However, I don't find it works for me -at all- when I'm on my period. Also, It'd be great if part of that single and/or pack -for this time of the month- talked about other super important aspects like your appeareance changing (bloating, acne...), losing some emotional stability due to hormones, etc.). I also think there should be a pack for pregnancy, and one to help people from the LGBTQ+ community (a pack for when you're being bullied, when you're transitioning, when you're discovering your own sexuality and/or gender identity, etc.). Thanks for reading this!!!!!!!

I really like Headspace, the meditations are relaxing, easy to follow, and you can set up reminders! However what you can do free is limited. The sleepcasts were my favorite but after I listened to a few they became locked. If I had the money I totally would pay for Headspace, but since I don't have the money, and the sleepcasts were my fave . . . I deleted the app. Maybe someday when I'm not poor I'll get a subscription.

The talks and meditations are great, but the app itself is frustrating. When in an area of low signal, which is where I, and many other people live, it automatically loads the 3 min meditation even though I almost never use it. And then, no matter how many times I try, it won't load any other duration, even if I go out of the app altogether and back in again.

This app got me into meditation, and, now, thirty days of daily meditation later, I have noticed remarkable effects on my anxiety and tendency to get lost in thought. There may be better or cheaper options out there but it has been absolutely worth my money and the features and presentation are just what I need without being overwhelming. I highly recommend this application, and, more broadly, getting into mindfulness meditation.

I am frustrated, for more than a year, the timer doesn't work well. When I set it for 15 or 20 minutes, it's not uncommon for it to give me a 5-minute or 10-minute meditation. The helpdesk told me to unload and reload the program. It still happens. As I say, I am frustrated. This app is not free, this is a silly ongoing glitch that's not really acceptable

The techniques in this app have helped me a lot. The guide's voice is really great at soothing. For the technical aspects of the app; it has a few bugs and quirks. If I do two courses on the same day, the day streak counts as two. Sometimes a course doesn't advance to the next day and I have to repeat it. The sleeping reminder doesn't go away when it's the next day. I would love for the app to engage do not disturb mode as sometimes I get messages or notifications when headspacing. I like this app very much and it is helping me a lot. Thanks.

The content is amazing but the app is buggy The screen freezes and crashes all the time and the downloads often download only a part of the whole practice. You can't download it again, either. Frustrating, and ironic considering that meditation itself helps to give you perspective and calm. Maybe its just their way of testing you... However, considering i paid $77 for a year, i would really expect a far, far better experience. This is what I pay for Netflix!!

Headspace is a good app and I enjoyed the 10 day trial. The tutor has a calm relaxing voice and the course is well layed out. However, I cannot justify the cost of Headspace when compared to other subscription programs. I mean, you can get a Netflix or Amazon Prime subscription for less than this and the amount of content they produce is thousands of times higher than Headspace. Good app but an unwarranted premium added because "it's a health app" or "it's only the cost of a cup of coffee each day"
This is a great app it helps with my anxiety

reviews.t: Make it part of your routine
reviews.x: I really enjoy this application. Starting out I was always worried if I was meditating ‘correctly’. Having a guide that does that for me is great. Having a library of multiple themes and lengths is great as well. While a years subscription looks like a lot, having the app updated constantly and using it almost daily makes it worth it.

I have found this helpful to increase my focus and reduce stress or at least become more aware that I am distracted or stressed. I particularly like the eyes open exercises and would like it if there were more of them perhaps in the form of a course. I actually tend to do most of my meditation sessions whilst commuting rather than at home and it works well for me but would be good to have more sessions specifically designed for when you are out or on the move. It would also be useful to have search functionality in the app.

This really helped me sleep, I love the meditation skills I've learnt, but after a few months of owning it, I find I can't use a single thing on it and i have to subscribe with money. I really needed it a few nights ago because I felt stressed and wound up and then I found i could not use a single thing on the app. Very annoying, but it is really good, and if you have money, go for it.

The male voice is very calming. I just can't justify the price. I'm only using the sleep pack and single. This is more expensive than netflix/amazon prime. I spend 1-2 hours on netflix everyday with $10 per month, versus 15 minutes on this app per day with $18 per month. I just can't justify the price.

Wanted to get rid of stress, this stressed me out more. After several minutes of signing up, answering questions and setting up a time for your phone to remind you to meditate, then went on to tell me that is going to show me a short video so I can learn how to meditate. That's when I yelled, and shut the app down to uninstall it. now for somebody that wants to get really in-depth with this it's probably a good thing I couldn't tell you one way or another that's why I didn't give it a one-star rating but for my needs I wish there was something saying this is not a quick start app so if you need stress immediately consider us in the future.

The app keeps glitching. I use a one plus 3 and I cannot load the mediation session most of the time if I don't force close the app and open it again. Even if I get to the mediation session, sometimes it will force close itself. Also it's almost impossible to complete the everyday headspace if I don't force close the app and open it again. Most of the time, if I want to meditate for 30 minutes a day, I will have to spend 5 to 10 minutes just to get to the mediation session successfully. When I use the web version of headspace, nothing of this sort happens. I update the app regularly but this is a problem that never gets resolved. I can't really use my laptop to meditate all of the time so please fix it. I've wasted so much time just to meditate for a short while on my one plus 3. None of my other app glitches like this so it's not the problem of my phone.

I really liked this app when I first used it, so much so that I purchased a subscription, which was not cheap. From the moment I spent my money, things went downhill. For the first week of my subscription, I couldn't access anything. Customer service was less than helpful. Since then, have had issues with meditations crashing, not working, or going silent after a few minutes. Customer service's response has been just reinstall the app. I wouldn't recommend you spend money on this unless you're up for a hassle.

Headspace has helped me a lot. Not advocating this as replacement for proper therapy, but I struggle with anxiety in daily life and this has helped me cope, and try to begin to understand it, I recommend this app to a lot of friends/family. However, a lot of people are complaining about the price of this app. In comparison, I know friends that pay £3-5 weekly for yoga/guided meditation classes, so when you think of that, £10 a month is not a lot in comparison. And if you can't afford the subscription, there are free packs you can listen to. It seems to me that a lot of love has gone into this app, and the skill it teaches you is irreplaceable. Paying to support apps like this is something I'm more than happy to do. The alternative is advertisments, and nobody wants ads while meditating.

I was only able the access the first basics pack as I can't really afford the cost. A lot of the things I actually needed were locked behind the pay wall. I need to wind down before bed but the sleepscapes didn't help. I can try one session of a few of the packs but it seems pointless. The app itself is good, it' s just a pity that it is so pricey

As a seasoned meditator, I enjoy Headspace for a refreshing way to view and approach meditation every day. The focus options for meditation topics are diverse and intriguing. Headspace is an incredible program that anyone can use -- from novice to expert meditators. Unfortunately there are definitely some kinks to figure out with the app functionality: often when I complete a session, it is not logged. Sometimes the meditation sessions stop half-way through (a big problem as you are left wondering whether the app is working and are distracted from your meditation session), and you cannot pre-download meditation sessions for when you're traveling out of service or turn off data. Otherwise, I highly recommend Headspace!

Really good app to get going into meditation. Would be nice if it could let you bind meditations so like for example I could run the basic one and after a balance or other pack one without having to open my eyes and then start breathing, scanning and all of it. I understand that not every pack would be compatible but maybe make the basic ones able to use them as intro/focusing for another meditation without having to come out of the meditative state of mind. Other than that highly recommended. Also I've seen a few comments regarding having to pay and to me it's perfectly fine. If you buy the year package is not that expensive and the fact that you paid makes you give it value and commit harder to the proces.

I really loved it! I think it has a grest guided meditation process and fun and interactive visual support... Never the less once you finish the beginners lessons you have to subscribe to continue using all its other features and lessons, which i was willing to do! But once i saw the prices i had to take a step back. Guys i think you have a great app but for some like me who have an average income in colombia, its not affordable to pay that price monthly nor even yearly. Thanks.

reviews.t: Love love love this app, buuuut
reviews.x: Since the newest update I haven't been able to mediate cause there's an error. It won't let me renew my membership. I tried making another account and it still isn't working. Please fix this, or I'm in going to need to find another app to meditate with.

I've been using this app on and off for a few years and it always seems like I'm coming home when I open it up. The new Daily meditations are such a good idea! So far I've loved them. My only thing is that I miss the Buddy part of the app. It was nice to be able to nudge or be nudged by my sister. Other than that, the packs are great, Andy's voice is soothing... it's just overall great!
This app has successfully helped me to create a daily practice of meditation. In this way...it is fantastic!! If you want to go deeper, a teacher is necessary.
Get it and you will see
